messages:
Alex P: Kicking off the BridgeWave interop pilot — partner wants EAP access to our rwd-v0.9 runtime on their A100 farm. NDA signed by legal yesterday. Need bench plan, telemetry hooks, and joint announcement timeline. Who can own the benchmark run next week?
Maria R: I can own benchmark ops. Need test list + instance types. Is there a perf target? :thinking_face:
Cheng L: Perf target asked by partner: p95/p99 latency targets — p99 < 120ms for 8k seq in throughput mode. They also want power draw logs and MQTT telemetry. I'll share the bench harness and telemetry adapter.
Samira K: Legal confirmed NDA. Partner also asked for a short non-public slide deck summarizing scope. They want a co-authored blog after results. Timeline? @OpsBot can you reserve infra window for the run?
OpsBot: Scheduled: bridgewave-pilot-slot-2026-03-25 09:00-13:00 UTC. Ticket created: RW-6721.
Alex P: Perfect. Maria, bench plan: 1) baseline (fp16) run, 2) quantized run (4-bit), 3) KV-cache warmup scenarios. Include power-meter wiring and telemetry validation. Use this command for the initial harness: ```bench --model rwd-v0.9 --instances 4 --seq 8192 --iters 500 --telemetry mqtt://telemetry.bridgewave.local:1883 --telemetry-cert /etc/certs/bridgewave.pem```
Maria R: Got it. I'll add power meter checklist and a short runplay with roles. Cheng — can you drop the harness link and vault path for creds? Need partner lab creds before we can run.
Cheng L: Harness link: https://internal.corp/bench/harness/bridgewave-v1. Vault path for creds: secret/partners/bridgewave — I'll DM the service account and key rotation notes.
Samira K: Marketing asks to hold public-facing blog until legal + partner approval. Proposed comms cadence: internal readout 2026-03-26, partner review 2026-03-27, joint publish 2026-04-02. OK?
Alex P: That works. Add a safety rollback: if perf regresses >5% from baseline, automatically fallback to rwd-v0.8 for partner-facing traffic and file incident. Also include an eval set for quality checks — use `bridgewave-core-100` eval set so partner metrics are comparable.
Maria R: Noted. I'll put the pre-run checklist into #eng-platform tomorrow morning. TL;DR: need two ops engineers + one ML lead for the run — tagging @Cheng and @Alex.
Cheng L: I'll be on-call for the run. Alex — can you confirm the partner-exposed MQTT endpoint and whether cert pinning is required?
Alex P: Confirmed: mqtt://telemetry.bridgewave.local:1883, cert pinned. Cert lives at /etc/certs/bridgewave.pem in the partner lab image. OpsBot — create an action to attach cert to RW-6721.
OpsBot: Attached cert to ticket RW-6721 and added the wired-power checklist to the run.
Samira K: Great, I'll draft the partner comms and non-public slide after the run results. :thumbsup:
